title: DSEffi-Bench: Demystifying Large Language Models' Capability in Efficient Data Science Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current data science (DS) code generation benchmarks equate correctness with quality, overlooking execution time differences that span orders of magnitude between correct solutions. We introduce DSEffi-Bench, the first benchmark specifically targeting execution efficiency in LLM-generated DS code, comprising 1,000 instances across 10+ DS libraries with stress-testing harnesses and human-validated references. Evaluating 16 models across 3 tiers, we find that correctness alone fails to characterize efficiency: GPT-5.4 leads in correctness (Pass, 66.9\%) but its efficiency score (B$|$P, 71.7\%) nearly matches GPT-5.4-mini (71.6\%), which solves 47 fewer tasks; Kimi-K2.5 ranks lowest in correctness among frontier models (40.2\%) yet achieves the highest efficiency score (73.6\%) across all 16 models. A human-annotated five-category taxonomy reveals that 79.1\% of efficiency deficits extend beyond algorithmic complexity to domain-specific roo

translated_title: DSEffi-Bench：揭秘大语言模型在高效数据科学代码生成方面的能力
translated_abstract: 当前的数据科学（DS）代码生成基准将正确性与质量等同起来，忽视了正确解之间跨越数个数量级的执行时间差异。我们提出了DSEffi-Bench，这是首个专门针对大语言模型生成的数据科学代码执行效率的基准，包含涵盖10多个数据科学库的1,000个实例，并配备压力测试框架和经人工验证的参考实现。通过对3个层级的16个模型进行评估，我们发现仅凭正确性无法刻画效率：GPT-5.4在正确性上领先（通过率66.9%），但其效率得分（B|P，71.7%）与GPT-5.4-mini（71.6%）几乎持平，而后者少解决了47个任务；Kimi-K2.5在前沿模型中正确率最低（40.2%），却在全部16个模型中取得了最高的效率得分（73.6%）。人工标注的五类分类体系显示，79.1%的效率缺陷不仅源于算法复杂度，还延伸至特定领域的根本原因。
tldr: 该论文提出首个专门评估大语言模型生成的数据科学代码执行效率的基准DSEffi-Bench，发现正确性与效率严重脱节——正确率最高的模型并非效率最优，而正确率最低的前沿模型反而取得了最高的效率得分。
en_tdlr: DSEffi-Bench, the first benchmark targeting execution efficiency of LLM-generated data science code, reveals that correctness alone fails to characterize efficiency—the model with the highest pass rate is not the most efficient, while the frontier model with the lowest correctness achieves the highest efficiency score.
